changes.comment: The Claude Code skill adapter's identity now includes each source root's child skill inventory (names and paths), not just the root itself, so renaming a bundled skill produces a new adapter key and a fresh materialization instead of being silently skipped by the existing cache. Renamed bundled skills (`teamwork`, `dynamic-workflow`) now materialize correctly for a Claude Code TeamLeader after an in-place upgrade of an existing installation, with no manual cache clear required.
